comment: Independent uhitm.c hmon_hitmon_splitmon() clone landing on a trap. A debug-mode dwarven Valkyrie steps north, then around the eight squares about her starting square, wishing for a squeaky board on each, and returns to the middle. She wields her dagger and creates a brown pudding, which appears to the south on one of the boards, and hits it until it divides; the new half lands on a neighbouring board, and the split calls trap.c mintrap(), which squeaks the board.
